source_text: Non-therapeutic infant male circumcision is not recommended routinely by the RACP, citing low incidence of preventable diseases, complication rates ranging from 0.4% to 16% (median 1.5%), and ethical concerns over the child's inability to consent to a non-reversible procedure with debated functional implications of the foreskin. [166]
